svg.title: Mercury-catalyzed alkyne hydration: Mechanistic boundary / grouped stage
svg.desc: Activated alkyne + H2O → Hydroxyvinylmercury intermediate + H+. Water addition, deprotonation and organomercury bonding are grouped; detailed speciation depends on acid and counterions.

g.text: Process model: no unique microscopic electron-arrow sequence asserted.
Water addition, deprotonation and organomercury bonding are grouped; detailed speciation depends on acid and counterions.
